parent_objective: design calibrated task-quality route after off-track dominated instrumented rerun
blocked_by: M1700 pivots to task-quality calibration because current workload is off-track dominated

public_gates: M1701 must design but not execute the calibrated task-quality route
M1701 must separate off-track, collision, obstacle pass, and max-step noncompletion metrics
M1701 must preserve P0 actor input contract and no profile-specific tuning
M1701 must specify source/spec/corridor/finish semantics checks before any rerun
M1701 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, private-holdout evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the calibrated task-quality route after M1700 pivot
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: task-quality calibration design only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if design ignores off-track dominance
stop if design allows profile tuning
stop if design changes actor inputs
stop if design claims ranking before calibrated audit
fallback_plan: route to calibration preflight if design is complete
route to branch stop if no calibrated metrics can be defined
route to workload redesign if source specs cannot be stratified

admission_evidence: M1700 pivots the branch because M1698 is off-track dominated
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1701 status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1701 is task-quality design and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design must retain L1, L2-current-tiled, L3-online, and L3-reset comparison rows in later calibrated evaluation
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If calibrated task-quality cannot separate boundary failure from obstacle avoidance, stop before controller ranking.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A task-quality calibration plan can define outcome-conditional metrics and workload checks that avoid ranking controllers on off-track dominated raw success.
success_criteria: design specifies corridor/boundary and finish semantics checks
design specifies source/spec stratification or filters
design preserves P0 actor input contract and no-tuning boundary
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design allows ranking from raw success
design changes actor inputs or profile configs
design routes directly to training or profile tuning
rollout execution training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: design
commands.command: write task-quality calibration design without execution

decision_rule: M1701 passes if it writes a calibrated task-quality design and routes to a separate preflight before any execution or ranking.
